text: I insured two dogs with Pet Partners one beginning in November of 2023 and another beginning in May 2024. For two dogs per month it was $112. On November 4th 2024 I was charged $283 for one month for two dogs, more than doubling my premium with no notification to me that this was going to happen. On December 4th again I was charged $283 for one month and that’s when I noticed the charge and realized that I had been charged the same thing for November. I called because I was sure there was a mistake. I was told Washington state just updated their insurance information on different breeds, which is ridiculous. I asked for a refund since number one my one dog was added in May 2024 so the year quote shouldn’t have changed until 5/2025 and two I wasn’t notified. I was told Pet Partners changed my policy to have both dogs renew at the same time so they could up my premium (I did not ask them to combine the two policy’s). It was just a way to get $283 a month out of me. They would not refund me and I couldn’t afford to keep two pets on their insurance so I only kept one at $167 a month. On February 4th 2025 they charged me $175 AGAIN the policy premium price went up without any notification to me. This company is out of control violating insurance fraud. My premiums should not change monthly. I want a refund for the entire year. I have not submitted any claims and I can’t afford a company that raises my premiums without me at least getting a noticed and a chance to look into different options. It did not know that they would be more than doubled almost tripled  during the Christmas season and I didn’t have an opportunity to look in advance for something different.

text:
I filed a claim which was denied by your company due to fabricated claim that it was a pre-existing condition. Theo started having symptoms of allergies 2 wks ago when we took him and was given an allergy shot. When I called your office, the rep read to me the notes “from the vet” stating that Theo had allergy symptoms back in January (which conveniently was prior to the start or his insurance coverage). I called the vet and as I expected, they did not have any documentation of any allergies on the visit in 01/24 or any at all until 07/02/24 when he was seen for that problem. 
I confirmed that when I requested Theo’s entire medical records. 
Fabricating a provider’s notes is not acceptable nor legal by any standards. When i called your office, I was told that the only way I could resolve this is by filing an appeal. Great! Taking time out of my already busy day to file a claim on something that should have been processed correctly to begin with. And I thought this was a reputable company. (Although, there really is NO reputable insurance company for that matter). I am a medical provider and I know this first hand through over 30 years of filing medical insurance claims and dealing with insurance companies. I was naive to think that pet insurance would actually do the RIGHT thing since they deal with animals who give us humans so much joy. Have a great day! I rated it one star because there was no option for a worse rating.
title: AKC fabricated my dog’s vet’s  records.
